findings.problem: The same English sentence already has one settled French rendering in this catalogue: "Actions pour {name}" (ui.chat.canonical.link_toolkit.actions_for, ui.library.menu.asset_actions_label, ui.settings.appearance.editor.more, ui.shell.sidebar_navigation.row_actions), plus "Actions pour {displayName}" and "Actions pour \"{title}\"". "sur" is this corpus's word for the article-bearing generic label ("Actions sur le fichier", "Actions sur l’image", "Actions sur l’élément"), never for a bare inserted name. "Actions sur {name}" also drops the determiner that makes "sur" idiomatic in French, so it reads clipped next to the four existing values; the glossary's one-term-one-decision invariant is what is broken here, not the meaning.
findings.recommendation: Actions pour {name} — matches the four existing renderings of this exact English sentence and keeps the determiner-free inserted name grammatical.

findings.problem: Defensible and grammatical; the only cost is the unelided "de" before a vowel-initial clip title ("Position de Audio 1" where French would elide to "d’Audio 1") and a possessive reading of "position". per_key_checks.assessment: Exact parallel of the shipped ui.chat.composer_media.pasted_file = "Fichier collé": feminine past participle agreeing with image, sentence case, no extension, no placeholder, 12 characters against the sibling's 13, no trailing punctuation. No maxCells on this key; the sibling's advisory 20 is met either way. Context note (synthetic name only, verbatim real names preserved) matches get-file-name.ts: both the missing-name and the throwing decodeURIComponent paths return this key.

"sur" vs the corpus's "pour" for this construction is the finding. Placeholder itself is sound: {name} byte-exact once, plain, no ICU needed, no elision or agreement hazard with an arbitrary inserted name (spaces, quotes, CJK, Latin), and the phrase is a noun phrase rather than an imperative. Sentence case, no trailing punctuation, 18 characters.

Byte-identical to the existing ui.canvas.files.imageActions = "Actions sur l’image" for the same English sentence, and parallel to ui.common.actions.file_actions_menu.file_actions = "Actions sur le fichier"; keeps the elided article that makes "sur" idiomatic. U+2019 only, no invisible characters, 19 characters, no trailing punctuation. Generic-label role (tooltip plus unnamed-image accessible name) is served; the named case is ui.common.actions.actions_for_name.

"Position" is the correct term for a seek slider (the corpus uses position for playback/board/pagination position), {label} is byte-exact and the word order change around it matches ui.chat.audio.play_label/pause_label. Names the clip's playback position rather than a play/pause action, as the context requires. No invisible characters, 19 characters, no trailing punctuation. N1 is the unelided "de" plus possessive reading, already precedented by date_time_picker.choose_date.

english_metadata_check.observation: Not a finding, outside the two named files: src/renderer/src/features/chat/components/attachments-preview.tsx keeps its own getFileName that returns t("ui.chat.composer_media.pasted_type", { mimeType }) for a non-image data URI with no name but with a MIME type, so on the composer chip strip a MIME-bearing unnamed non-image paste reads "Collé : {mimeType}" rather than pasted_file. The note is not wrong about the files it names; it just is not the only rendering of that input.
